'''Coldstone Canyon''' was a canyon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that was located southeast of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]]. The leaders of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group gathered there for convocations to discuss serious matters affecting their entire organization.
